notes.title: Taboo University Book Two Release 3 has launched!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/b17612ceb73e885c0df48cd28ada858fc23eeae8.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The new Release for [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/book-two-release-138097728"]Taboo University - Book 2 is now available.[/url][/b][url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/book-two-release-138097728"] [/url][/p][p][/p][p]👂❓ What's new, you ask? Good question! Lots - that's what. [/p][p][i]Each of the storylines reaches a tense climax in this chapter,[/i] setting the stage for the entire rest of the game - it's deep, it's emotional, and most importantly, it's hot as fuck - with Mc reaping the many, many benefits.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/162ed295b46dab2e8efd08f84724a59a564063e6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🥇In the Winner's club, we've got you being torn between many of the tense and worried characters of the club, all looking to you for support:[/p][p]-- [b]Monika [/b]of all people is looking for any chance to blow off some steam, and seeing you and Olesya being casually friendly during a practice is just the bad reason she needs to make a sexy scene out of herself for you.[/p][p]-- [b]Isa [/b]needs help as well! With no one else to turn to in confidence, she seeks you out to ask for your help in her election efforts amid the drug scandal. Should you be on her path instead of Sam's, she's even willing to trust you to help calm her nerves a bit...[/p][p]-- [b]Silvia [/b]is feeling a little isolated with all the negativity as well, and unfortunately, she's been pretty swamped to the point of frustration, leading her to take some indulgent initiative with her new boyfriend the first chance she gets![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/c3d1c35843a31e50ee7cb85197f42d0b0566dd52.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🍃Meanwhile, the mysterious Children of Narrura are far from idle. Mc makes some serious investigative plays in this chapter in order to learn more information.[/p][p]- Fortunately, [b]Delphia [/b]has always been someone to find enjoyment in breaking the rules, and fortunately, when she finds out you're sneaking around, she is turned towards rewarding you rather than chastising you.[/p][p]- Afterward, someone else is looking to do a little rule-breaking of her own... [b]Ivy [/b]wants another taste after your previous tryst, and she has just the plan to wear out the rest of the communers - [b]Yvonne, Sloan, and Nirium[/b] -  to get some private time with you.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/937a267c28550063b60a8d8ecf3a0d16be0bed55.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]💰Finally, big happenings in the Syndicate.[/p][p]- If you were brave (or foolish) enough to make contact with [b]Corrine [/b]before her more altruistic sister, it's time for her to earn her keep - in exchange for bail. With her back on the streets, though, she's more than poised to make that everyone else's problem... and your pleasure.[/p][p]- And it's time to find out if the Wasp's money is where their mouths are. The task of testing this supposed golden business deal falls to you, [b]Zemfira and Foxy[/b]. It's good - it's better than good, even. And at Zemfira's prodding, it might get even better...
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/2285299aa7bc40f8087437ca0cf356e730457193.png"][/img][/p][p]
And that's just the beginning. There's tons more to see waiting for you, culminating in a big, big decision for Mc to make at the end. Faced with the results of the choices he's made so far, it's time to stop passing the buck... who are you? What do you want? And what are you willing to do to get it?[/p][p]

🔥 [b]17 shining scenes
[/b]🔥 [b]2700 stunning renders
[/b]🔥 [b]166 original animations[/b][/p][p]The hour is here - no more waiting. Time to act.[i] [/i]Dive back into the world of [i]Taboo University[/i] today![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/e2b77e62decccdda105efd026afca44dcd8dddb9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Devblog - Chapter 12 Preview 2
notes.content:
[p][b]Chapter 12 - Progress Report 2[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/78ffd63ea0e33f5a9cdaab6eee381d595267f797.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're cracking away at [b]Taboo University - Book 2.[/b] Chapter 12 is going to take you deeper into the Cult than you've ever gone before. On the Winner's Club front, everything is in disarray, and you have to rally the troops to keep the group from falling even further.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Winner's Club[/b][/p][p]It is a dark time for the Winner's Club. Everyone is stressed out and unsure of what the next day will bring.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/875317da34c3070f46163a8901cda8a10aa2979c.png"][/img][/p][p]And what's more, it's time for another volleyball match. It will be up to you to help rally the troops as you and the team push onward to try claiming a new Win.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/39b5d78ccb4b9bac9052dff9d1bf20705efc4e42.png"][/img][/p][p]That is, if you can keep them from killing each other before the match starts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/e2c67429afb51d23d89045688008eec8e35dfbf0.png"][/img][/p][p]Whatever happens, there is a silver lining waiting for you at the hotel if you have been involved with Silvia.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Cult[/b][/p][p]When you signed up for the cult, it's a sure bet you had no idea just how crazy your life would become as you explored the mysterious and ritualistic organization.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/be6eeb2058d426164337f1e17e10759e0f4ba415.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]With a little sneaking around, it is finally time to investigate the catacombs on your own. You just hope that Lumi and Nia can keep the others busy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/b293c431df1d396c62a7f7405f3ef2207567b88c.png"][/img][/p][p]Who knows what is waiting for you in the depths?[/p][p]



[/p]

notes.title: Devblog - Chapter 12 Preview 1
notes.content:
[p][b]Head's up, everyone![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/c2b4bf55a7a5d05a67a1995421e1a7bc93a22ec1.png"][/img][/p][p]It's time for a check-in on your investigation and everything going on with TU Book 2's development. [/p][p]Just like many hard-boiled detective series, things are heating up all across the campus[/p][p][/p][p]The relationships between roommates can always be complicated affairs. In this chapter, the situation between Laura, Josie, and you is going to reach a whole new level of entanglement.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/6cfa9dbf77b467924daedff765ccb6c9131e385a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/2285299aa7bc40f8087437ca0cf356e730457193.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In this post, we can preview a bit from one faction, everyone's favorite set of sports fanatics, the [b]Winner's Club.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/162ed295b46dab2e8efd08f84724a59a564063e6.png"][/img][/p][p]The shadow of the scandal is starting to push everyone's buttons. Brigitta is trying to keep things going, but you know her. Her personality doesn't leave much room for people to have thoughts of their own. You should watch your back when you're out there on the sand.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/fee97a88b6a0adf3932afbb181131aecd00fbab7.png"][/img][/p][p]Of course, it's not all bad news. After practice, Monika approaches you about doing a little one-on-one team building.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/7d5afcde1c2bbed534f2db57c63305880c1ddaf7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And lastly, Isa is still up to her old tricks as she investigates the Winner's Club. The question remains… Just how deep are you prepared to go to complete your investigation?[/p][p][/p][p]And that's all we want to tease for today. Don't worry, there will be more posts like these in the future. We hope you like what you've seen so far, and we'll make sure to update everyone when we are a little closer to the next Taboo University Update.[/p][p]Have a great week![/p][p]
[/p][p]-Vinovella [/p][p]
[/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: The 9th update of Fetish Locator: S&M Studio is live on Patreon!
notes.content: [p][b][i]Hey, friends![/i][/b][/p][p]Since the point when you and Stacy left everything behind to chase your dreams and conquer the world of adult cinema, it’s all been leading to this. This is the moment in the adventure where fantasies become reality, and ideas take form on screen. [/p][p][/p][p]In the [b][url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/135260237"]ninth release of S&M Studio[/url],[/b] you’ll shoot your very first [b]feature-length film[/b] in your own studio—complete with models, sets, and a script that you and your team brought to life together.[/p][p]This is far more than just a technical leap forward. It’s a creative milestone, packed with passion, challenges, and ambition. And with so many juicy behind-the-scenes events, you’ll get to see familiar characters in entirely new ways. [/p][p][/p][p]Working with Stacy, Kanya, and Taisia, you’ll go through every step of production: writing the script, building the sets, designing costumes, and finally shooting your masterpiece. This storyline of making a movie is the heart of the 9th release—and trust us, you won’t want to miss a second of it. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/ca4fd2b21f66fc5c9745c5d6583f03bc2257aff5.png"][/img][/p][p]But the action doesn’t stop on the set. A sudden [b]cyberattack[/b] hits the IT department’s servers—and now the whole team is counting on you and your brilliant tech experts, April and Nari.[/p][p]You’ll need to act fast and work as one to stop the threat and save the project. And after that kind of stress, there’s only one thing left to do… help the girls unwind. [/p][p][/p][p]Let’s start with [b]Claire[/b]. A closed-door office meeting with her quickly turns into something far more personal. Just be sure to be mindful that in the office, you never know who else is watching. [/p][p][/p][p]If you've stuck around through [b]April's [/b]stubbornness, you'll now get to see a new side of her as she tries to balance her work at Orbix and her responsibilities to her bandmates. The code monkey offers you a chance to go for a jog in the park, just be sure to keep up, or you might miss out on the thrilling ending.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/2a2b910dd0957e27dc5e5da5a32655cd1b0db907.png"][/img][/p][p]For fans of [b]Lyssa[/b], we’ve got a double treat in this update. First, you’ll head out on a playful and colorful [b]date at the amusement park[/b] with both Lyssa and Stacy. Then, back at your studio, get ready for a [b]sizzling[/b] [b]photoshoot[/b] with the sexiest lawyer you know.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/563690fc8390de0602ee4156e162e15f4528e2e7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]💥 Here’s what’s waiting for you in this release:[/b][/p][p]— [b]25 new scenes [/b] [/p][p]— [b]3718 new renders [/b] [/p][p]— [b]251 animations[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We want to thank each and every one of you for your patience, support, and love for this project. You’re the reason we keep pushing ourselves to make each update better than the last. [/p][p][/p][p]And just a reminder—[b]S&M Studio now has an official Steam page [/b]so you can wishlist it right not to stay updated.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3763690/Fetish_Locator_SM_Studio/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]See you on set! 🎬💋[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🖤Taboo University: Book Two’s second release is live on Patreon!🖤
notes.content:
As always, three factions — three completely different worlds, and once again, each faction brings you a variety of new events.

An abundance of beautiful girls, steamy scenes, and new adventures await — as always!

We’re excited to announce that the [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/book-2-release-2-127605901?utm_medium=clipboard_copy&utm_source=copyLink&utm_campaign=postshare_fan&utm_content=web_share][b]second release of the second book of Taboo University is now available on our official Patreon page[/b][/url]!

Here’s what you’ll find in this update:
[b]
[h3]❤️ The Syndicate. [/h3][/b]
Get ready for a scorching evening in the company of the fiery Zemfira.
Together, you’ll head to a strip club, where she will take the spotlight with her bold, provocative dances and playful glances, completely capturing your attention.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/f582638fd046bbae7e0d86f0d130fd7c7e980139.gif[/img]

And if you're craving even more dancing and pleasure, you’ll find it with the hot and eager trio: Nirmala, Q, and Sabrina. They will draw you into an atmosphere of tenderness, deep relaxation, and pure bliss.

[h3][b]🖤 The Cult. [/b][/h3]

This release is filled with sacred rituals.
One of them takes place under the shroud of secrecy in a hidden location, drawing you closer to the girls of the Cult. You'll take part in a mesmerizing ceremony, with the sensual Irene by your side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/415c1bee21934d48d0e3c21d5bbc905ee5224423.png[/img]

Later, Lumi will invite you to witness an intimate moment — the creation of her new tattoo. You'll become part of a quieter yet deeply personal ritual, a symbolic act of loyalty and connection to the Cult.
This process is filled with both pain and beauty — and it’s up to you to help Lumi turn the pain into something much more pleasurable.
And maybe, just maybe, you'll find yourself drawn to the mysterious tattoo artist, Nia.

[h3][b]👑 The Winners.[/b][/h3]

Transformation and loss of control await you.
Silvia, shining in her new look, will quickly turn what starts as an innocent makeover into an unstoppable, passion-filled party, with the stylist Iona swept up in the heat of the moment. Get ready — this wave of desire will be hard to contain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/3a370477084b31b24ad8da29a505dd2c7c526ec7.gif[/img]

And your relationship with the seemingly untouchable Brigitta will grow dangerously close. Confined spaces will do their work, pushing the tension to the breaking point.
Here, there will be no room left for hesitation or restraint — only raw, overwhelming passion.

[b]This release includes:
🔥 16 new scenes
🔥 2291 new renders
🔥 279 animations[/b]

[i]Each scene is a deeper step into the heart of the story.
Each heroine brings a new challenge for your emotions.[/i]

⚡[b] You can download the new release on our official Patreon page:
👉 [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/book-2-release-2-127605901?utm_medium=clipboard_copy&utm_source=copyLink&utm_campaign=postshare_fan&utm_content=web_share]Click here to access the release[/url][/b]

[b][i]❗ PS: The second book will be available on Steam only after it’s fully completed.
We are working on it non-stop — and trust us, the hottest parts are still ahead. ❗
[/i][/b]
🔥 We sincerely thank you for your patience and support while waiting for this release.
Your belief in the project inspires us to move forward and make each chapter even brighter and more emotional.

Thank you for staying with us!
Your Taboo University Team 🖤
